'''Gerzob''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Revelations" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gerzob system/Legends|Gerzob system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the creature known as the [[Yellow-Bellied Green-Proboscis Marsupial]].<ref name="Revelations" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gerzob was mentioned in "[[Polarization: Revelations|Revelations]]," a [[2005]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure authored by [[Margaret van Poelgeest-Heintz|Margaret Heintz]] that served as the second installment of the [[Polarization trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.<ref name="Revelations" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gerzob [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square R-18.<ref name="TEA" /> Although the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book later placed the Gerzob system in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> the [[2012]] [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors] feature of the Online Companion established that the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and grid square R-18 did not, in fact, intersect.<ref name="OuterRim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-outer-rim-sectors|text=The Essential Atlas Extra: Outer Rim Sectors|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
